hebrewText: וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶחָ֑י/ו לִ/רְע֛וֹת אֶׄתׄ צֹ֥אן אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם בִּ/שְׁכֶֽם

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
tokens.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanation: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanationEn: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanation: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.bdb: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
tokens.kjv: chief, (fore-) father(-less), [idiom] patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.
